snippet.title: Welcome to Springfield - Fortnite | The Simpsons
snippet.description:
Fortnite Battle Royale has crashed into Springfield! Read more about the new Season in our blog: https://fn.gg/TheSimpsons. Drop into Springfield and explore iconic Simpsons locations including The Simpson’s house on Evergreen Terrace, the Springfield Nuclear Plant, Burns Manor, and much much more. 

#TheSimpsons #Fortnite
